text: さらに　けんきゅうが　すすめられ　のうりょくが　たかまった。

structure.jp: さらに　けんきゅうが　すすめられ
のうりょくが　たかまった。

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb says the thing was done by someone not named. けんきゅうが　すすめられ = 'research was carried forward'.

patterns.name: 〜連用形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: Stopping a verb at its ます-stem, without ます, joins it to the next part like 'and'. It is the written-style version of the て-form. すすめられ = 'was carried forward, and'.
